notes:
Context: Cardinal Echo Labs is a 70-person B2B SaaS startup building an embeddable in-app chat assistant for mid-market product teams (their product: Flowboard). Inbound via self-serve sign-up; early discovery. Fast-moving engineering team; wants to validate hosted API before considering Dedicated.

Why Redwood fit: they asked specifically for an inference provider that supports low-latency streaming, prefix/KV caching and easy SDK integration — Redwood hosted API + optimize suggestions attractive.

Requirements / asks (from tech call):
- Workload: live in-app assistant (multi-tenant), predominantly short-turn chat (avg turn ~18 tokens).
- Targets: p50 < 80ms token, p95 < 200ms for streaming single-token latency; end-to-end user-visible latency target < 300ms for typical replies.
- Throughput: ~40 qps peak during product demo (expected to scale to 200 qps in 6 months).
- Models: prefer small/quantized LLMs for cost/latency (open weights ok), want automated fallback to larger model when quality drops.
- Streaming: websocket/Server-Sent-Events integration; need token-by-token stream support and reconnect resilience.
- Caching & routing: sticky sessions and prefix/KV cache per customer to reduce tokens and hit latency SLOs.
- Cost sensitivity: strong — early stage; wanting clear estimates and recommendations from Optimize on batching/quantization.
- Security: SOC2 is important; audit logging desired. SSO is not required yet. No strict data residency needs (US-based customers today).

Quotes: "Users abandon UI after ~500ms delay — streaming is table-stake for us." — Product lead.

Internal notes: AE to send streaming demo + simple perf harness and a recommended token budget for 2-week POC. SE to propose caching config and suggested model family. Finance needs billing card before paying beyond free credits.

Decision signals: interest to convert within 2–3 months if POC shows consistent p95 < 200ms and predictable token spend.
use_case_summary: SMB inbound: self-serve signup -> discovery. Building low-latency in-app chat assistant with streaming + KV caching. Trialing Redwood hosted_api, needs perf baseline and cost guidance from Optimize.
